business_summary: Bunka Shutter Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells building materials in Japan, Australia, and internationally. It operates through Shutter Related Products; Building Materials Related Products; Service Business; Renovation Business; and Other segments. The company offers garage, lightweight, heavy, panel, high-speed sheet, and window shutters, as well as overhead sliding and hangar doors, vinyl curtains, and smoke protection and disaster prevention products. It also provides sliding/folding, steel, hotel, heat resistant, and apartment doors; fire resistant equipment with heat resistant glass; stainless-steel joinery; pre wall partitions for schools, aluminum, steel, glass, and low partitions; sliding walls, toilet booths, toilet booths for kindergarten children, and free access floors; and indoor stairs, outdoor steel staircase, chain gates, and handrails and cappings, as well as decks, louvers, and fences. In addition, the company offers water stop master series, heat-shielding products, solar power generation systems, and PCR testing booths; maintenance and repair services for existing shutters and building materials; alteration and extension services for houses; and replacement and repair of household equipment. Further, it engages in water-sealing, solar power system, real estate leasing, insurance, and architecture design businesses. The company was formerly known as Japan Bunka Shutter Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Bunka Shutter Co., Ltd. in April 1970. Bunka Shutter Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1951 and is headquartered in Bunkyo, Japan.
